SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.

2. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   A. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.
   C. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)

   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

10. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Hide all money underground

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
